question: Pradeep says, "Vishal's mother is the only daughter of my mother". How is Pradeep related to Vishal?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8f4ee4534eea80969d7fb51913847c35b53b29bd5fe2bd7b9a9cbeea087636a.png] 

The family tree are given below -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9733be663b96c87318c6d1b94dc98d17ff63555e518c0832ca6a104b77507526.png] 

Pradeep is the maternal Uncle of Vishal.

Hence, **"Maternal Uncle"** is the correct answer.
